name: DefectAugment defense live demo profile
purpose: Use short live runs to prove the pipeline, and use saved formal results to prove model quality.

formal_results.ratio_ablation_best: 300 generated samples, 3-seed mean best validation accuracy 98.70%; 600 generated samples has 95.74% mean final validation accuracy
formal_results.multiseed_best: cGAN-v2 600 samples average best validation accuracy 99.44%, baseline 98.15%
formal_results.industrial_gate: 600-sample setting passed: min recall 98.33%, cost-weighted error 0.29%
formal_results.classifier_comparison: small_cnn 96.11%, mobilenet_v3_small 95.56%, resnet18 93.33% in the formal backbone comparison run

talk_track: 现场短轮次训练用于展示数据读取、ROI 预处理、GPU 调用、Loss 曲线、断点续训和文件输出。
正式生成效果不依赖现场随机训练，而是展示 40 轮 cGAN-v2 模型、质量指标、比例消融和多随机种子验证。
若老师要求看完整训练，可说明完整实验已保存 checkpoint、summary、曲线和证据图，现场重新训练会浪费答辩时间。
目标检测验证当前证明 XML 标注读取和检测训练链路可运行；GAN ROI 样本没有 bbox，因此不直接混入检测训练。
